clarifications.topic: Whole-image annotation coverage before any future execution
clarifications.finding: All7newpositiveTRAIN records have cropXYXYInOriginal. Restoring their originalfullphoto does not automatically restore labels for objects outside the annotatedcrop. Step1 should distinguish the currently labeled prepared-image extent from an uncropped original; step2 needs full annotation/explicit supportedignore/quarantine before unseenforeground can be treated as background. This is a plan clarification, not a claim currenttraining already used invalidlabels.
clarifications.suggestedText: 先以当前完整标注的准备图像范围做整图/切片对照；若恢复原始全皿照片，须补齐ROI外标注或使用明确支持的忽略/隔离方案，不能把未标注菌落当背景。
